weaknesses.what: 'Cannot hear audio' message conflicts with the fact that the AI is clearly capturing speech and timestamps. This creates uncertainty about whether something is broken or if this is expected.
weaknesses.fix: Remove misleading audio warnings, or clarify that audio monitoring is working. Use clear status indicators (recording, processing, ready).

weaknesses.what: 'Waiting for...' placeholder sections in Decided Items and Things to Do break the flow. You see some notes filled in (Memo section) but other sections appear empty, making it unclear if extraction is complete.
weaknesses.fix: Either hide incomplete sections entirely, show a consistent loading state, or populate all sections before showing the UI. Avoid mixing filled and placeholder content.

weaknesses.what: No explanation of who these speakers are, what project this relates to, or why this meeting matters. The three-digit meeting code '02:38' is cryptic.
weaknesses.fix: Add a subtle header with meeting title, date, participant list, or meeting purpose above the current title.

weaknesses.what: The right panel with transcription snippets is sparse and requires scrolling. The bottom message 'AI is viewing material -- not yet available' wastes vertical space without adding information.
weaknesses.fix: Either show more transcription content, hide the unavailable materials message, or use that space for meeting summary or action items in a more compact way.
